meta.status: defaults proposed by the agent; Daniel can change any of them in plain words

plain_policy: Keep a queen Miles bed with both sides reachable; keep at least today's storage; keep the laundry sorter in the room; every everyday route at least 22 inches wide; priorities in order: everyday walkway, storage, fewest changes, cost.

pinned.bed_finish: Toasted Oak frame, Twill Sand headboard

required.storage: dresser or chest drawer volume at least equal to today's nine cube organiser cubes (about 9 x 11 x 11 x 11 cubic in), or keep the cube organiser
required.nightstands: two preferred; one allowed with a warning; existing pieces allowed

bed_orientations: head south only if no door swing behind it (closet wall)

excluded.miles_dresser_60: owner: about 57 in is the maximum on the west wall

passage.labels: rules of thumb, not code; IRC R311.6 36-in hallway is a reference only
passage.routes: hall door clear opening to: each bed side, closet door approach, front of each storage piece, the white door, the operable windows
passage.drawer_standing: drawer extension plus 16 in to stand at an open drawer (one drawer at a time)

doors.shaker_door: must open to at least 90 degrees (a piece may be the stop)
doors.entry_door: must open fully to the south wall
doors.closet_door: must open to at least 90 degrees

windows.policy: each window must stay openable and reachable: no tall piece in front; a headboard over the casing or stool is a warning; a nightstand or low dresser below the stool is fine

child_safety: anchor every dresser and chest; flag climbable pieces under a window

classes.invalid: breaks a required item, a door rule or a route minimum at the best estimate
classes.conditional: passes at the best estimate but fails in a plausible scenario; say which measurement settles it

ranking: filter, cluster (bed wall, route pattern, furniture mix), pick distinct representatives, then sort by the plain_policy priorities; show Today plus four first, then up to eight
